description: Search public golf courses (currently NYC metro) with official tee-time booking links. Filters are optional. Courses with unknown fee/location are excluded only when that filter is set. Does not check live tee-time availability; `date` is echoed back with booking-window notes.

max_fee.description: Max USD; matches courses whose green_fee_max <= max_fee (or green_fee_min if max unknown)

name: search_courses
title: Search golf courses
